components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The screen's main action: a square green slab that only changes colour.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: Alexandria, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 160ms, color 160ms; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green-2, #145a45); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--green, #0b3d2e); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green-2, #145a45); } .ds-btn-primary[disabled] { background: var(--line-hair, #e2e2dc); color: var(--ink-2, #55574f); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The second action: a square ink outline that takes the shelf wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding-inline: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #121311); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #121311); font-family: Alexandria, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--raise, #f3f3ef); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green-2, #145a45); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A square field with a hairline edge; focus thickens it to 2px green without growing.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Alexandria, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink, #121311); } .ds-input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-ink, #c9cac1); border-radius: 0; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #121311); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 300; transition: border-color 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #75776e); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #75776e); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--green-2, #145a45); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--green-2, #145a45); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: No box: a line on a form, 2px ink underline turning green on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; font-family: Alexandria, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #121311); } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; inset-inline-start: 0; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding-inline: 34px 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #121311); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300; transition: border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-2, #55574f); } .ds-search input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: var(--green-2, #145a45); }

components.name: Size Chip
components.description: Square hairline chip; selected fills ink, sold out is struck through.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; font-family: Alexandria, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { min-width: 56px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line-hair, #e2e2dc); border-radius: 0; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #121311); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms, background 160ms, color 160ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #121311); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green-2, #145a45); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #121311); border-color: var(--ink, #121311); color: #fff; } .ds-chip[data-out="true"] { background: var(--raise, #f3f3ef); color: var(--ink-3, #75776e); text-decoration: line-through; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-biglist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-hair, #e2e2dc); font-family: Alexandria, sans-serif; } .ds-big { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding-block: 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-hair, #e2e2dc); color: var(--ink, #121311); text-decoration: none; transition: color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-big__name { font-family: 'Reem Kufi', Alexandria, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 56px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-big__thumb { order: 1; flex: none; width: 0; height: 72px; background: var(--raise, #f3f3ef); opacity: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: width 550ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-big__n { order: 2; margin-inline-start: auto; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-2, #55574f); } .ds-big:hover, .ds-big:focus-visible, .ds-big:hover .ds-big__n, .ds-big:focus-visible .ds-big__n { color: var(--green-2, #145a45); } .ds-big:hover .ds-big__thumb, .ds-big:focus-visible .ds-big__thumb { width: 150px; opacity: 1; } .ds-big:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green-2, #145a45); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Neighbourhood shops, presented the way a serious fashion house presents a collection: a white wall, near-black type, photographs given room, and one deep bottle green that takes whole bands of the page instead of being sprinkled as accents. The shop is still a place on a street. The presentation just stops looking like a delivery app.

The structure is lines, not boxes. Rows sit on 1px hairlines, grids share their seams, and a card is almost never a bordered rectangle. The type does the shouting: Reem Kufi set very large, like a shop sign, on page titles, section heads, shop names and the big list rows, with Alexandria at weight 300 for everything a shopper reads or taps. Corners are square everywhere. Depth exists only on the few things that really float over the page.

Visual rejections, confirmed by the owner: the cream-plus-serif look, the stone-plus-grain look this storefront used before, rounded cards, soft decorative gradients, and Talabat's saturated orange, promo-banner register.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, near-black ink, one bottle green that owns whole regions.
Square corners; round only for things that are round by nature.
Hairline rules instead of boxes; shared-seam grids.
Reem Kufi display set huge; Alexandria 300 body; tabular Latin figures.
Red means a price drop or a failure. Nothing else.
Shadows only on what floats: the inset hero photo, menus, sheets.
RTL by `dir` alone; layout by container queries on `.lq-shell`.

rules.name: The Whole Band Rule
rules.body: Green arrives as a region (a band, a plate, a filled button), never as scattered accent text, icons or borders. If a screen has green confetti on it, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Go / Stop Rule
rules.body: GREEN = go: available, open now, confirmed, add to cart, focus ring, cart count, checked filter, primary action. RED = stop: a price that dropped, and something that failed. Nothing else. A red focus ring or cart badge reads as an error on the one control the shopper is meant to use.

rules.name: The No-Opacity Text Rule
rules.body: Text colour is never set with `opacity`. Use `ink-2` or `ink-3`. A disabled row steps its title to muted colour; it does not fade.

rules.name: The Shop Sign Rule
rules.body: Reem Kufi is for names and titles set large. Never for body text, labels, buttons or prices.

rules.name: The Untracked Arabic Rule
rules.body: Never letter-space or uppercase Arabic. Tracking pulls a cursive script apart at the joins and uppercase does nothing to it. Every tracking token in the system is 0.

rules.name: The Latin Figures Rule
rules.body: Numerals are Latin in both languages, always tabular and lining. `450 ج.م` in Arabic, `EGP 450` in English. A shelf price has no decimals; anything being reconciled (a total, a fee, a refund) has two. An order number must be readable over the phone (`LQ-4821-7730`).

rules.name: The Brand Name Rule
rules.body: The brand is written `loqaaal`, in Latin letters, in every language. The wordmark is set `direction: ltr` so an RTL page does not reverse it.

rules.name: The Container Rule
rules.body: Layout switches are container queries on `.lq-shell` (`container-type: inline-size`), never width media queries. A 430px phone frame embedded in a desktop page must still lay out like a phone. The chrome switch is 720; wide is 1024.

rules.name: The Logical Properties Rule
rules.body: `dir="rtl"` is the only switch. Logical properties throughout (`inset-inline-start`, `margin-inline-end`, `border-block-end`), no `left`/`right`, not one mirrored rule. Directional icons mirror with `scale(-1, 1)` under RTL. Titles and paragraphs set `unicode-bidi: plaintext` so a Latin shop name in an Arabic row keeps its own punctuation.

rules.name: The Only-What-Floats Rule
rules.body: If it does not sit above other content, it has no shadow. Cards, rows, buttons, tiles and grid cells never cast one, and nothing moves on press.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: A rounded rectangle anywhere is a regression.

rules.name: The Shared Hairline Rule
rules.body: Grid cells share borders: a 1px gap over a `line-hair` background, closed top and bottom. Never a border per cell, which draws every interior edge twice.

dos: **Do** give green whole regions: the featured band, the footer, the primary button.
**Do** separate content with 1px hairlines and section spacing, not boxes.
**Do** set titles, shop names and big rows in Reem Kufi, large.
**Do** set body in Alexandria 300 and every figure tabular and lining, in Latin numerals.
**Do** keep every pair at WCAG 2.2 AA: body text 4.5:1 or better, `ink-3` (4.6:1) is the floor.
**Do** keep hit targets at 44px, 52px for the screen's primary action.
**Do** carry state with a word as well as a colour.
**Do** switch layout with container queries on `.lq-shell` and write logical properties only.
**Do** focus with a 2px `green-2` outline at 3px offset.
**Do** write the brand as `loqaaal`, and Arabic copy in Modern Standard Arabic.
donts: **Don't** round a corner, except the round-by-nature set in Shapes.
**Don't** put a shadow on anything that does not float, and never a hard offset shadow.
**Don't** use red for anything but a price drop or a failure.
**Don't** letter-space or uppercase Arabic, and don't put a small tracked label above a section.
**Don't** use a decorative gradient; the only gradient is a legibility scrim over a photograph.
**Don't** return to stone and paper grain, cream with a serif, rounded cards, or Talabat orange.
**Don't** use a native `<select>`, a centred modal, or a spinner over content.
**Don't** use a width media query for layout, or `left`/`right` properties.
